description: Everything the site holds on one project, by its id from find_projects, search_projects or a project page (/data/projects/{id}), whichever tracker lists it: name, sector, technology, capacity as stated with any other ratings and what the figure covers, stage with the source’s own words, place (locality and region only, never coordinates), dated milestones (planned or actual), disclosed investment, published tariff or levelised cost, the companies and their roles and published shares, the owner’s sourced facts, and every publication the row was compiled from with the date it was read. asOf is the date the tracker last read the project. Answers anyone, as the project’s public page does.

locale.description: Language of names and labels; default en

name: get_project
title: One project, with its sources
